meta.title: Boone County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Boone County's 2026 final budget, adopted by Appropriation Ordinance 2025-39 on December 9, 2025. We use the single 'Budget 2026' column of the detailed budget pages. The General Fund total comes from the ordinance and includes $543,289.34 that County General sends to the 911, District Court Probation and Public Defender funds, so those dollars are counted twice: once in County General and again where they are spent.

nodes.name: County General
nodes.note: Fund total is the 'TOTAL GENERAL FUND' printed in the appropriation ordinance (Section 5, p. 3), which the ordinance says includes transfers into and out of County General. The detailed budget pages show Transfers Out as $0.00; the ordinance's Section 4 (pp. 1–2) lists transfers from County General of $468,289.34 (to 911, fund 3020), $30,000.00 (to District Court Probation, fund 3027) and $45,000.00 (to Public Defender, fund 3024), which add to the gap. Printed total is $11,696,861.45; the departments listed add to $11,153,572.11.
